A surprise to be sure but a welcome one. Microsoft is bringing original Xbox - and almost certainly Xbox 360 - emulation to PC and we've got a quartet of games to look at. Tom examines the new emulator on a high-end PC, stacking up its results against Xbox Series X before moving on to ROG Xbox Ally X, with some welcome results. There are issues here, but as first step, this is impressive stuff.
